scraper.code:
function listPosts({url,$}) { const posts=[]; $('item,entry').each((_,e)=>{ const x=$(e); const link=x.find('link[rel="alternate"]').attr('href')||x.find('link').attr('href')||x.find('link').text(); if(link && !link.endsWith("/")) posts.push({url:link,title:x.find('title').first().text().trim(),publishedAt:x.find('pubDate,published,updated').first().text().trim()}); }); return {posts,next:null}; }
function parsePost({url,$}) { const title=$("h1.article-title").first().text().trim(); const publishedAt=$('meta[property="article:published_time"]').attr('content')||$('time[datetime]').first().attr('datetime')||$('.date').first().text().trim()||null; const author=$('meta[name="author"]').attr('content')||$('.p-author').first().text().trim()||null; const body=$("article.popover-hint").first().clone(); body.find('script,style,noscript,nav,footer,.upvote,.tags,.blog-tags,.post-tags,.subscribe-widget,.subscription-widget,.comment-list,.comments').remove();  return {title,bodyHtml:body.html()||'',publishedAt,author,tags:$('a[rel="tag"]').map((_,e)=>$(e).text().trim()).get()}; }
scraper.notes: 實讀 Quartz RSS、資料夾索引與 CWES 通關心得文章。feed 的目錄頁以斜線結尾，排除索引後只列真文。文章標題 h1.article-title，正文 article.popover-hint（目錄版型是 div.popover-hint > article，不混用）。
